resources.string: It protects this account on this phone. Between %1$d and %2$d characters.
Type or paste the 24 words of the account, separated by spaces.
Word %1$d is in no recovery phrase.

These 24 words are your account. With them you can open it on any machine. Anyone who has them can read everything you store. If you lose them and every machine of this account, nobody can give it back.
Write them down somewhere safe, or keep them in a password manager.
Other apps can read what you copy. ITSaNAS clears it after 60 seconds.
Type these words from the list you wrote down.
That is not it. Look at the words again and retry (%1$d tries left).
Three misses: the words are shown again.
Nothing here yet. Add a file, or sync with one of your machines.
Choose a folder to keep in your account
New files in %1$s go to your account by themselves. Deleting one here leaves it there.
Not synced with any of your machines for %1$d h. Check that this phone is online and that your other machines are on.
Not synced with any of your machines for %1$d days. Check that this phone is online and that your other machines are on.
Machines that failed a storage check: %1$d. What they hold no longer counts as a copy of your files.
Only %1$s free on this phone. Free some room: saving fails when it is full.
Your files are not safe yet: %1$d of the %2$d copies they need exist outside this phone. If you lose it now, what is missing is gone.
It goes from every machine in this account, not just this phone. There is no undo.
This phone runs %1$s. Android asks before installing it.
Allow ITSaNAS to install apps in Android\'s settings. The offer comes back the next time the app opens.
Unlock with your fingerprint or face?
ITSaNAS then opens after a fingerprint or face check instead of keeping your passphrase ready. Adding a new fingerprint to this phone turns it off until you type the passphrase again.
Fingerprint or face unlock was not turned on.
